title: Deposit rates to discount factors (money-market)
deliverables: per-pillar table [P]: maturity, discount factor, zero rate
frame: DIKETAHUI: deposits [P]: tenor/maturity date, quote r (percent -> decimal), day count (ACT/360 or ACT/365F); curve anchored at spot. DITANYAKAN: DF and zero rate (continuous unless stated) per deposit [P]. RUMUS: card Core 1: DF(T) = 1/(1 + r tau); Core 6: z = -ln DF / t; toolkit zero_rate(df, t, compounding). JAWAB: 1) tau = days/360 (or 365). 2) DF = 1/(1 + r tau). 3) curve time t (curve basis, often ACT/365F). 4) z = -ln DF/t. 5) check DF decreasing, reprice r = (1/DF - 1)/tau.
pitfalls: using the same tau for accrual and curve time without stating it

title: Deposits with spot lag: ON/TN to spot discount factor
deliverables: per-pillar table [P]: DF from today
frame: DIKETAHUI: ON and TN rates; deposits starting at spot [P]; day counts. DITANYAKAN: DF from today for spot and each deposit maturity. RUMUS: card Core 1: DF(spot) = 1/((1+r_ON tau_ON)(1+r_TN tau_TN)); DF(T) = DF(spot)/(1 + r tau(spot,T)). JAWAB: 1) DF(ON) then DF(spot). 2) deposits from spot. 3) times from today. 4) zeros. 5) check deposit reprices with DF(spot) anchor.
pitfalls: anchoring at spot with DF(spot)=1 when today-anchored curve is asked

title: FRA chain bootstrap
deliverables: per-pillar table: DF at each FRA end
frame: DIKETAHUI: deposit for the first period; FRAs [P] t1 x t2 with rates F; day count. DITANYAKAN: DF at every FRA end date; zero rates. RUMUS: card Core 2: DF(t2) = DF(t1)/(1 + F tau12); if t1 not a pillar interpolate DF(t1) by stated rule. JAWAB: 1) DF from deposit. 2) loop FRAs in order of t2. 3) DF(t1) from existing pillars. 4) DF(t2). 5) zeros, check FRA reprice: (DF1/DF2 - 1)/tau = F.

title: Futures strip with convexity adjustment
deliverables: per-contract table: futures rate, convexity adj, forward rate, DF
frame: DIKETAHUI: futures [M]: price, start t1, end t2 (years); sigma (short-rate vol) if given; starting DF. DITANYAKAN: forward rate per contract and DFs at t2 [M]. RUMUS: card Core 2: F_fut = (100 - price)/100; F_fwd = F_fut - 0.5 sigma^2 t1 t2 (Hull); V4 (a). JAWAB: 1) futures rate. 2) adjustment (continuous compounding in Hull; convert). 3) DF(t2) = DF(t1)/(1 + F tau). 4) chain. 5) zeros; check adj grows with t1 t2.
pitfalls: no adjustment applied when sigma is given

title: Futures strip without volatility (no convexity adjustment)
deliverables: per-contract table: implied forward, DF
frame: DIKETAHUI: futures prices [M], period dates; no sigma. DITANYAKAN: DF and zeros from futures-implied forwards. RUMUS: card V4 (b) when no sigma: F = (100 - price)/100 treated as forward; DF chain. JAWAB: 1) F per contract. 2) tau per contract day count. 3) DF chain from first DF. 4) zeros. 5) state no adjustment used.

title: Single-curve swap bootstrap with consecutive annual pillars
deliverables: per-pillar table [P]: DF, zero rate, reprice error
frame: DIKETAHUI: par swap rates [P] at annual maturities 1..N (no gaps), fixed leg annual, accruals tau_i. DITANYAKAN: DF, zero rate per pillar; repricing errors. RUMUS: card Core 3: DF(T_n) = (1 - S sum_{i<n} tau_i DF_i)/(1 + S tau_n) (spot start, DF(T0)=1); toolkit swap_rate_and_annuity. JAWAB: 1) sorted pillars. 2) loop n: annuity of known DFs. 3) solve DF_n. 4) zeros. 5) reprice S = (1 - DF_n)/A_n; error ~ 0.
formulas: DF_n = (1 - S_n sum_{i<n} tau_i DF_i)/(1 + S_n tau_n)

title: Swap bootstrap with missing pillars via log-linear root-find
deliverables: per-pillar table: DF, zero; coupon-date DF table
frame: DIKETAHUI: par swaps at sparse maturities (e.g. 1,2,3,5,7,10); annual fixed leg; interpolation log-linear DF. DITANYAKAN: pillar DFs such that each swap reprices exactly; DFs at intermediate dates. RUMUS: card Completing: intermediate coupon DFs depend on the new pillar -> brentq on ln DF_n; log-linear: ln DF linear in t between pillars. JAWAB: 1) pillars in order. 2) for a new pillar guess ln DF_n; interpolate ln DF at gap coupon dates. 3) swap value residual. 4) brentq. 5) all intermediate DFs. 6) check repricing < 1e-10.
formulas: ln DF(t) = linear interp of ln DF between pillars
pitfalls: flat-extrapolating last DF inside the gap

title: Swap bootstrap with linear-in-zero interpolation
deliverables: per-pillar table: DF, zero rate
frame: DIKETAHUI: par swaps [P] with gaps; interpolation stated linear in zero rate. DITANYAKAN: pillar zeros reprice each swap; forward curve. RUMUS: card V1 (b): z(t) linear between pillars; DF = exp(-z t); root-find each new pillar. JAWAB: 1) new pillar unknown z_n. 2) interpolate z at gap dates, DF. 3) residual. 4) brentq. 5) forwards (saw-tooth expected). 6) reprice check.

title: Par bond bootstrap, annual coupons
deliverables: per-maturity table: DF, zero (annual or continuous)
frame: DIKETAHUI: par yields c_n [P] for annual maturities 1..N, price 1. DITANYAKAN: DF and spot rates per maturity. RUMUS: card Core 4: d(n) = (1 - c sum_{i<n} d(i))/(1 + c); toolkit bootstrap_par(maturities, par_rates, freq=1). JAWAB: 1) decimal par yields. 2) recursive DFs. 3) zeros in stated compounding. 4) check par bonds price to 1.

title: Treasury CMT par curve: bills short end plus semi-annual coupons
deliverables: per-tenor table: DF, zero rate
frame: DIKETAHUI: CMT par yields [P] at 1M..30Y (percent). DITANYAKAN: DFs and zeros at each tenor (and at semi-annual coupon grid). RUMUS: card V5 (a): T < 1: DF = 1/(1 + y T); T >= 1: semi-annual par bond 1 = (c/2) sum DF + (1 + c/2) DF_n with interpolated grid; toolkit bootstrap_par(grid, par, 2) or par_curve(maturities, par_rates, 2) (linear par interp onto grid). JAWAB: 1) bills simple. 2) semi-annual grid 0.5..30; interpolate par yields or root-find. 3) recursive DFs. 4) zeros continuous. 5) reprice.

title: Bootstrap from non-par coupon bond prices
deliverables: per-bond table: DF at maturity, zero
frame: DIKETAHUI: bonds [B] (maturities on a common coupon grid), coupons, dirty prices. DITANYAKAN: DF at each maturity and zeros. RUMUS: P_n = sum_{k<n} (c/f) F DF_k + (1 + c/f) F DF_n -> DF_n = (P_n - (c/f) F sum_{k<n} DF_k)/((1 + c/f) F). JAWAB: 1) sort by maturity. 2) dirty = clean + AI. 3) recursive DFs. 4) gaps -> interpolation root-find. 5) zeros; reprice.

title: Zero curve from zero-coupon bond prices
deliverables: per-maturity table: DF, zero rate
frame: DIKETAHUI: zeros [P]: maturity, price per face. DITANYAKAN: DF and zero rate in stated compounding. RUMUS: DF = price/face; card Core 6 conversions; toolkit zero_rate. JAWAB: 1) DF. 2) z continuous = -ln DF/T; annual DF^(-1/T) - 1; periodic f(DF^(-1/(fT)) - 1). 3) check monotone DF.

title: Zero rate compounding conversions
deliverables: per-pillar table: z_cont, z_annual, z_semi, z_simple
frame: DIKETAHUI: zero rates [P] in one compounding, tenors. DITANYAKAN: zero rates in other compoundings. RUMUS: card Core 6 via DF: DF = exp(-z_c t) = (1+z_a)^-t = (1+z_f/f)^(-f t) = 1/(1+z_s t); toolkit discount_factor, zero_rate. JAWAB: 1) DF from given compounding. 2) invert for each output. 3) check round trip.

title: Forward rates between adjacent pillars (continuous)
deliverables: per-interval table [P-1] (or [P] with row one rule): forward
frame: DIKETAHUI: pillar DFs or zeros [P]. DITANYAKAN: forward between consecutive pillars; how first row is filled (from t=0). RUMUS: card Core 7: f = ln(DF1/DF2)/(t2-t1) = (z2 t2 - z1 t1)/(t2-t1); toolkit forward_rate(df1,t1,df2,t2,compounding). JAWAB: 1) sort. 2) first row: forward from 0 = z1. 3) forwards. 4) telescoping check sum f dt = z_N t_N.

title: Simple (money-market) forward rates table
deliverables: per-period table: start, end, forward simple
frame: DIKETAHUI: DF curve; period grid [n] with day count. DITANYAKAN: simple forward per period. RUMUS: card Core 7 simple: F = (DF1/DF2 - 1)/tau. JAWAB: 1) DF at period ends (interpolated). 2) tau. 3) F. 4) check FRA reprice.

title: Instantaneous forward curve from log-linear DFs
deliverables: grid table: t, f(t)
frame: DIKETAHUI: pillar DFs [P]; output grid [G]. DITANYAKAN: instantaneous forward at each grid point. RUMUS: card Core 7 f = -d ln DF/dt; log-linear -> constant between pillars; at a pillar use right-hand forward. JAWAB: 1) for t in (t_i, t_{i+1}]: f = ln(DF_i/DF_{i+1})/(t_{i+1} - t_i). 2) at pillar: right side. 3) beyond last: flat zero -> f varies, or flat forward per V6.

title: Model par swap rate at arbitrary tenor from built curve
deliverables: per-tenor table: par rate, annuity
frame: DIKETAHUI: built DF curve with interpolation; tenors [Q]; fixed freq. DITANYAKAN: par rate and annuity per tenor. RUMUS: card Completing: S = (1 - DF(T))/A, A = sum tau_i DF(T_i); toolkit swap_rate_and_annuity(dfs, times, freq). JAWAB: 1) payment grid. 2) DFs by interpolation. 3) A, S. 4) check at pillars S = input.

title: Reprice all input instruments as curve check
deliverables: per-instrument table: quote, model quote, error (bp)
frame: DIKETAHUI: instruments [P] and built curve. DITANYAKAN: model quote and error per instrument. RUMUS: card Invariants: |model - quote| < 1e-8; deposits (1/DF-1)/tau, FRA, swaps (1-DF)/A. JAWAB: 1) model rate by instrument type. 2) error in bp. 3) max abs error. 4) flag failure.

title: OIS (SOFR/ESTR) curve bootstrap
deliverables: per-pillar table: DF, zero, reprice error
frame: DIKETAHUI: OIS par rates [P]: <=1Y single payment, >1Y annual fixed ACT/360 (or ACT/365F GBP). DITANYAKAN: OIS discount factors and zeros. RUMUS: card Core 1 for <=1Y: DF = 1/(1 + r tau); Core 3 for longer with annual payments; gaps root-find. JAWAB: 1) short pillars simple. 2) annual pillars recursive / root-find. 3) zeros. 4) reprice.
formulas: DF_n = (1 - S sum tau_i DF_i)/(1 + S tau_n)

title: Dual curve: projection (IBOR) curve with OIS discounting
deliverables: per-pillar table: projection DF, forward; repricing errors
frame: DIKETAHUI: OIS DF curve (built first); IBOR swaps [P] (fixed freq, float tenor). DITANYAKAN: projection-curve pillars repricing IBOR swaps under OIS discounting. RUMUS: card Core 5: F_j = (P(t_{j-1})/P(t_j) - 1)/tau_j; S = sum tau_j F_j DF_ois(t_j) / sum tau_i DF_ois(t_i); root-find each pillar. JAWAB: 1) OIS curve. 2) for each swap: unknown projection pillar. 3) forwards from projection, discount on OIS. 4) brentq. 5) check repricing and projection above OIS.
formulas: S = sum_j tau_j F_j D(t_j) / sum_i tau_i D(t_i)
pitfalls: discounting with the trial projection curve

title: Tenor basis swaps: 3M vs 6M projection curves
deliverables: per-pillar table: 6M projection DF
frame: DIKETAHUI: OIS curve; 3M projection curve; 3M vs 6M basis spreads [P]. DITANYAKAN: 6M projection pillars repricing basis swaps. RUMUS: PV(3M leg + spread) = PV(6M leg), both discounted on OIS. JAWAB: 1) 3M forwards and leg PV. 2) spread leg. 3) unknown 6M pillar -> 6M leg PV. 4) brentq. 5) check.
formulas: sum tau3 (F3 + b) D = sum tau6 F6 D

title: Interpolation comparison: forward shape under different methods
deliverables: grid table: zero and forward per method
frame: DIKETAHUI: pillar zeros/DFs [P]; methods; grid [G]. DITANYAKAN: zeros and forwards per method on grid; smoothness metrics. RUMUS: card V1; Hagan-West 2006. JAWAB: 1) build interpolants. 2) evaluate DF, z. 3) forwards by difference. 4) roughness (sum of squared second differences). 5) negative forwards check.

title: Cubic spline on g(T) = z T with g(0) = 0
deliverables: grid table: z, DF, forward
frame: DIKETAHUI: pillar zeros [P]; instruction to spline g = z T including point (0,0). DITANYAKAN: zeros, DFs, forwards on a grid. RUMUS: card Conventions: do exactly as worded; scipy CubicSpline(t, g, bc_type as stated); f = g'(t). JAWAB: 1) t = [0, pillars], g = [0, z t]. 2) spline. 3) z = g/t, DF = exp(-g). 4) f = spline derivative. 5) check reprice at pillars.

title: Extrapolation beyond last pillar: flat zero vs flat forward
deliverables: table: DF and zero at extended tenors
frame: DIKETAHUI: pillars [P]; query tenors beyond ends. DITANYAKAN: DF/zero at extrapolated tenors per V6. RUMUS: card V6: (a) z(t) = z_N; (b) f = last forward: ln DF(t) = ln DF_N - f_N (t - t_N); before first pillar flat zero. JAWAB: 1) identify region. 2) apply rule. 3) report method.
formulas: flat fwd: DF = DF_N exp(-f_N (t - t_N))

title: Nelson-Siegel yields from given parameters
deliverables: per-tenor table: yield
frame: DIKETAHUI: beta0..beta2, lambda (form tau/lambda or lambda tau), tenors [P]. DITANYAKAN: NS yield per tenor; limits. RUMUS: card Core 8: y = b0 + b1 (1-e^-x)/x + b2[(1-e^-x)/x - e^-x], x = tau/lambda. JAWAB: 1) x per tenor (check form). 2) loadings. 3) y. 4) check y(0+) = b0 + b1, y(inf) = b0.
formulas: y(tau) = b0 + b1 L1 + b2 L2

title: Nelson-Siegel fit with fixed lambda (OLS)
deliverables: summary json: betas, rmse; fitted vs observed table
frame: DIKETAHUI: observed yields [P]; lambda fixed. DITANYAKAN: betas by OLS, fitted yields, RMSE. RUMUS: card Conventions: with lambda fixed, linear in betas: X = [1, L1, L2]; lstsq. JAWAB: 1) loadings matrix [P x 3]. 2) np.linalg.lstsq. 3) fitted, residuals. 4) RMSE in bp.

title: Nelson-Siegel full nonlinear fit including lambda
deliverables: summary json: betas, lambda, rmse
frame: DIKETAHUI: observed yields [P]; start values / bounds / optimizer as given. DITANYAKAN: betas, lambda, RMSE. RUMUS: objective on yields (not prices) unless stated; scipy least_squares/minimize from given start; or grid over lambda with OLS betas. JAWAB: 1) set start. 2) optimise. 3) or profile: for lambda grid OLS -> best. 4) RMSE. 5) check b0 > 0.

title: Svensson model fit and evaluation
deliverables: summary json: parameters, rmse; fitted table
frame: DIKETAHUI: observed yields [P]; start values. DITANYAKAN: Svensson parameters and fitted yields. RUMUS: card Core 8: add b3 [(1-e^-x2)/x2 - e^-x2], x2 = tau/lambda2. JAWAB: 1) model function. 2) optimise (bounds lambda > 0). 3) fitted, RMSE. 4) check vs NS (RMSE not larger).

title: Diebold-Li time series of NS factors
deliverables: per-date table [T]: b0, b1, b2; summary: AR(1) params, forecast
frame: DIKETAHUI: yield panel [T x P] (monthly, maturities in months), lambda fixed (Diebold-Li form x = lambda tau). DITANYAKAN: factor series, AR(1) per factor, h-step forecast. RUMUS: card Core 8 Diebold-Li note; OLS per date; AR(1) b_t = c + phi b_{t-1} + e. JAWAB: 1) loadings with lambda tau. 2) per-date OLS. 3) AR(1) per factor. 4) forecast factors, map to yields.

title: NS instantaneous forwards and discount factors
deliverables: per-tenor table: zero, forward, DF
frame: DIKETAHUI: NS parameters; tenors. DITANYAKAN: NS zero (continuous), instantaneous forward, DF. RUMUS: card Core 8: f = b0 + b1 e^-x + b2 x e^-x; DF = exp(-y tau). JAWAB: 1) zeros. 2) forwards. 3) DF. 4) check f(0) = y(0) = b0 + b1.
formulas: f(tau) = b0 + b1 e^-x + b2 x e^-x

title: Par yields from a parametric (NS/Svensson) zero curve
deliverables: per-tenor table: par yield
frame: DIKETAHUI: parametric zero curve; tenors; coupon freq. DITANYAKAN: par yields per tenor. RUMUS: par c = f(1 - DF_n)/sum DF_k; from DFs on the coupon grid. JAWAB: 1) DF on coupon grid. 2) annuity. 3) par. 4) check upward curve: par < zero.

title: Off-market swap NPV from built curve
deliverables: per-swap table: NPV, par rate, annuity
frame: DIKETAHUI: swaps [M]: notional, fixed rate K, maturity, freq, pay/receive; DF curve (single or dual). DITANYAKAN: NPV per swap in currency. RUMUS: payer NPV = N (DF0 - DF_n - K A) single curve; dual: N (sum tau F D - K A). JAWAB: 1) payment grid DFs. 2) A. 3) float PV. 4) NPV sign by direction. 5) check NPV = N A (S - K).

title: Swap PV01 and annuity
deliverables: per-swap table: annuity, PV01
frame: DIKETAHUI: swaps [M]; DF curve. DITANYAKAN: annuity and PV01 per swap. RUMUS: card Completing: PV01 ~ N A 1e-4. JAWAB: 1) A = sum tau DF. 2) PV01 = N A 1e-4. 3) optional bump-and-rebuild comparison.

title: Bucketed curve deltas by quote bumps and re-bootstrap (Jacobian)
deliverables: matrix [M x P]: PV change per 1bp quote bump
frame: DIKETAHUI: instrument quotes [P]; portfolio [M]; bump 1bp. DITANYAKAN: delta of each position to each input quote. RUMUS: bump quote k by 1bp -> rebuild curve -> reprice; Jacobian dz/dq if asked. JAWAB: 1) base curve and PVs. 2) for each k bump, rebuild. 3) deltas. 4) sum ~ parallel par DV01.

title: Forward-starting swap rate
deliverables: per-swap table: forward swap rate, forward annuity
frame: DIKETAHUI: DF curve; start T0, tenor, freq. DITANYAKAN: forward swap rate and annuity. RUMUS: card Core 3: S = (DF(T0) - DF(Tn))/A; toolkit swap_rate_and_annuity(dfs, times, freq, df_start, t_start). JAWAB: 1) DF(T0) and grid DFs. 2) A. 3) S. 4) check vs spot-start when T0 = 0.

title: Diagnose generator's interpolation convention by repricing residuals
deliverables: summary json: residuals per candidate method, chosen method
frame: DIKETAHUI: instrument prices/quotes possibly synthetic; candidate interpolations. DITANYAKAN: which method reprices to ~1e-10; resulting curve. RUMUS: card Conventions: right interpolation gives ~0 residual on off-pillar instruments. JAWAB: 1) build curve per method on subset. 2) reprice the others. 3) compare RMSE. 4) pick, but stated method wins.

title: Mixed-instrument curve: deposits, futures, swaps
deliverables: per-pillar table: source instrument, DF, zero
frame: DIKETAHUI: deposits, futures, swaps with overlapping maturities; selection rules. DITANYAKAN: single DF curve; instrument used per pillar. RUMUS: card Core 1-3 by segment; drop overlaps by stated rule (e.g. deposits to 3M, futures to 2Y, swaps beyond). JAWAB: 1) select instruments. 2) deposits. 3) futures chain (adjusted). 4) swaps root-find with interpolation. 5) reprice all used.

title: Overdetermined bond curve by least squares
deliverables: summary json: parameters, RMSE; per-bond errors
frame: DIKETAHUI: bonds [B] > curve parameters; model (pillar zeros or NS). DITANYAKAN: parameters minimizing (weighted) price or yield errors. RUMUS: min sum w_i (P_i - P_model,i)^2, w_i = 1/D_i^2 for yield-like errors. JAWAB: 1) param -> DF. 2) model prices. 3) optimise. 4) residuals in price and bp.
formulas: min sum w_i (P_i - sum CF DF)^2

title: DF lookup at arbitrary dates via interpolation
deliverables: per-date table: t, DF
frame: DIKETAHUI: pillar curve [P]; query dates [Q]; curve day count. DITANYAKAN: DF per query date. RUMUS: card V1 default log-linear: ln DF interp in t; curve time from dates with curve basis. JAWAB: 1) t = yf(valuation, date). 2) interpolate ln DF. 3) extrapolate per V6. 4) check DF(0)=1.

title: Zero curve from a set of DFs
deliverables: per-maturity table: zero rate
frame: DIKETAHUI: maturities and DFs [P]. DITANYAKAN: zero rates and maybe forwards. RUMUS: toolkit yield_curve_from_dfs(maturities, dfs); zero_rate. JAWAB: 1) validate 0 < DF <= 1. 2) zeros. 3) forwards. 4) check round trip.

title: Par curve from zero curve
deliverables: per-maturity table: par rate
frame: DIKETAHUI: zero rates or DFs at annual (or f) grid; freq. DITANYAKAN: par rates. RUMUS: par = f(1 - DF_n)/sum DF on the coupon grid (inverse of toolkit bootstrap_par; toolkit par_curve(maturities, par_rates, freq) goes the other way: interpolates par quotes and returns t, df, zero_continuous). JAWAB: 1) DFs on full grid. 2) cumulative annuity. 3) par. 4) check bootstrap of par returns DFs.

title: Telescoping and consistency checks on built curve
deliverables: summary json: check flags and residuals
frame: DIKETAHUI: built curve (DF, zero, forwards). DITANYAKAN: invariant checks. RUMUS: card Invariants: sum f_i dt_i = z_N t_N; DF(0)=1; decreasing DF; par/zero/forward ordering. JAWAB: 1) compute each check. 2) residuals. 3) flags.

title: FRA valuation off a built curve
deliverables: per-FRA table: forward, PV
frame: DIKETAHUI: FRAs [M]: notional, contract rate K, t1, t2; curve(s). DITANYAKAN: forward and PV per FRA. RUMUS: PV = N tau (F - K) DF(t2) (long pays fixed); dual curve: F from projection, DF from OIS. JAWAB: 1) F. 2) DF(t2). 3) PV. 4) sign by direction.

title: Implied forward rate n x m with periodic compounding
deliverables: table: forward per (start, length)
frame: DIKETAHUI: spot rates [P] (annual or f compounding). DITANYAKAN: forward rate for start n years, length m years. RUMUS: (1+z_{n+m})^{n+m} = (1+z_n)^n (1+f)^m. JAWAB: 1) DFs. 2) f = (DF_n/DF_{n+m})^{1/m} - 1 (annual). 3) convert compounding.

title: Shape relations: par, zero and forward ordering
deliverables: table: par, zero, forward per tenor; flags
frame: DIKETAHUI: curve (par or zeros). DITANYAKAN: all three curves and ordering checks. RUMUS: card Invariants: upward -> forward > zero > par at long end; inverted reverse. JAWAB: 1) compute three curves. 2) compare. 3) flag.

title: Semi-annual swaps with coupon dates before first pillar
deliverables: per-pillar table: DF, zero
frame: DIKETAHUI: swaps with semi-annual fixed leg; first pillar 1Y (no 6M quote). DITANYAKAN: pillar DFs; DF at 6M treatment stated. RUMUS: card Completing: flat-extrapolate first zero to earlier coupon dates (state) or solve jointly. JAWAB: 1) choose rule. 2) for 1Y swap: DF(0.5) = exp(-z1 0.5) with z1 unknown -> brentq. 3) continue. 4) reprice.

title: Parallel and key shifts of zero curve -> new DFs
deliverables: table: shocked DF and zero per pillar per scenario
frame: DIKETAHUI: zero curve [P]; scenarios [S] (bp). DITANYAKAN: shocked zeros and DFs [S x P]. RUMUS: z' = z + dz(t); DF' = exp(-z' t); shapes via np.interp. JAWAB: 1) dz per pillar. 2) z'. 3) DF'. 4) check monotonicity.

title: Curve from Treasury yields: convert yields to par then bootstrap
deliverables: per-tenor table: DF, zero
frame: DIKETAHUI: on-the-run bonds: coupon, yield, maturity. DITANYAKAN: spot curve. RUMUS: price each bond from its yield (toolkit bond_price), then bootstrap from prices. JAWAB: 1) prices. 2) recursive DF (interp gaps). 3) zeros. 4) reprice yields.

title: Compounded overnight rate accrual for an OIS float leg
deliverables: per-period table: compounded rate, accrual amount
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily overnight fixings [D] with day weights n_i; period; ACT/360. DITANYAKAN: compounded rate and float amount. RUMUS: R = (prod (1 + r_i n_i/360) - 1) 360/D; amount = N R D/360; forward-looking periods: (DF_start/DF_end - 1)/tau. JAWAB: 1) weights per fixing (weekends carry). 2) product. 3) rate. 4) amount. 5) future periods from OIS curve.

title: Interpolated zero rates on an output grid
deliverables: grid table: t, zero, DF
frame: DIKETAHUI: pillars [P]; output grid spec. DITANYAKAN: zero and DF on grid. RUMUS: card V1/V6. JAWAB: 1) grid. 2) interp per stated method. 3) extrapolate. 4) units percent/decimal as asked.

title: Bootstrap with toolkit bootstrap_par then forwards and reprice
deliverables: per-pillar table: DF, zero, forward, reprice error
frame: DIKETAHUI: par rates on regular grid, freq. DITANYAKAN: full pillar table. RUMUS: toolkit bootstrap_par(maturities, par_rates, freq) -> DFs; zero_rate; forward_rate. JAWAB: 1) DFs. 2) zeros. 3) forwards. 4) reprice par bonds to 1; irregular quotes: par_curve(maturities, par_rates, freq) interpolates par linearly (flat before first) then bootstraps.

title: Hull-White-consistent curve inputs: DF function for model calibration
deliverables: summary: callable curve, f(0,t) table
frame: DIKETAHUI: pillar DFs; need for smooth f(0,t) (short-rate model). DITANYAKAN: a curve function DF(t) and forward f(0,t). RUMUS: smooth interpolation (spline on ln DF); f = -d ln DF/dt numerically (toolkit hull_white_zcb takes curve_fn). JAWAB: 1) build interpolant. 2) curve_fn(t). 3) forward via derivative. 4) check reprice of input DFs.

title: Missing quote completion: interpolate par rate vs solve pillar
deliverables: per-pillar table with source flag (quoted/interpolated)
frame: DIKETAHUI: par rates with missing tenors that the coupon grid needs. DITANYAKAN: complete curve; documented treatment. RUMUS: option A: linear interpolation of par rates at missing grid tenors then closed form (toolkit par_curve); option B (default): root-find with DF interpolation (card Completing).
